svg.title: NET-10-U — Failed session refresh
svg.desc: NET-10-unavailable. Failed refresh after selected populated results; cached rows/details hidden, necessary refresh reason retained, Join selected disabled, upper Refresh focused. Canvas origin (25,20); SVG uses the top-left origin. Production bottom-left: unchanged Browse panel (24,24), 802 by 544; body edges inset 8 px from the outer frame, with 4 px clear inside the bevel when focused. Heading (32,490), 786 by 20; white list (32,248), 786 by 242; detail border (32,108), 786 by 128, retaining 8 px inner padding and 12 px list separation. Footer: (32,32), (300,32), (568,32), each 250 by 32 with 18 px gaps. Conditional paging uses y=72. Refresh (706,518), 112 by 24, moves left 4 px only. Preserve complete inline error under UX-NET-10-037, title chrome, text size, removed-caption omissions, hidden-input rules, focus/traversal, identity recovery and independent Direct connect.

g.text: Directory unavailable. Direct connection and local play are still available.
Refresh successfully before joining. Availability unconfirmed.
Retained six-column heading strip; empty white body with one full noninteractive error line.
Cached rows and selected identity/endpoint/mode hidden. Refresh focused.
Recovery restores retained identity only if present, never another session.
Status and paging allocations stay reserved; conditional paging group unchanged.
